difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Theorem 7.3.2 at source lines 514-517: for any family P over trunc n A whose fibers are n-types, and any g : prd a:A P(|a|_n), there is a section f with f(|a|_n) := g(a). The proof (source lines 518-526) is not a citation of the constructors: one has to build two of the three data by hand, first defining t(x) := trans (s_r(x))(r'(x)) so as to land in the single type P(h(r)) (source line 522), and then using the fact that P(h(r)) is n-truncated to obtain both a point u and a contraction v at u (source line 523). Only then do h'(r,r') := u and the contraction v, read through the unfolding of dependent paths, supply the second and third data (source lines 524-525).
